You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: How often must the HINOWA elevating platform at position 24 of the IGEA list be verified?

Facts:
[0] regular inspection of machinery or related product — verifiedBy — designated bodies (designated bodies) [condition: may be subject to national requirements for regular inspection] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.10]
[1] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (annex IV point 16) [DIR, Annex IV]
[2] periodic verifications of comma 11 for equipment in annex VII — verifiedBy — Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco (Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco) [condition: relativamente alle attrezzature riportate nell'allegato VII di cui dispone a titolo di proprietà o comodato d'uso] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13-bis]
[3] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (vehicle servicing lifts) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
[4] guards at landings — requiresMeasure — interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier (interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier) [condition: hazardous movements of the carrier until the guards are closed and locked] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.5]
[5] machinery serving fixed landings — listedIn — 6.4. (Annex I, point 6.4) [DIR, Annex I, 6.4]
[6] 4.3.3 lifting machinery, maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[7] adjustment and maintenance points — requiresMeasure — located outside danger zones (located outside danger zones) [REG, Annex III, 1.6.1]
[8] periodic audits — verifiedBy — The notified body (the notified body) [DIR, Annex X]
[9] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall use the appropriate verification methods (shall use the appropriate verification methods) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.1]
[10] operator — hasObligation — have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times (have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times) [REG, Annex III, 1.7.1.2]
[11] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[12] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: in order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.5]
[13] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.4]
[14] operating position — requiresMeasure — adequate cabin (adequate cabin) [condition: Where appropriate] [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.7]
[15] datore di lavoro, controllo dopo ogni montaggio — hasObligation — dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto (dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro la cui sicurezza dipende dalle condizioni di installazione] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[16] guards at landings — requiresMeasure — interlocking device with guard locking controlled by the position of the carrier (interlocking device with guard locking) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.8.5]
[17] adjustment and maintenance points — requiresMeasure — must be located outside danger zones (must be located outside danger zones) [DIR, Annex I, 1.6.1]
[18] operating position cabin — requiresMeasure — adequate cabin (adequate cabin) [condition: Where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.7]
[19] 4.1.2.7 operating position of machinery — requiresMeasure — widest possible view of trajectories (widest possible view of trajectories) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.7]
[20] modalità di effettuazione delle verifiche periodiche — hasTimeLimit — entro dodici mesi (P12M) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13]
[21] vibration values — hasObligation — must be either those actually measured for the machinery in question (must be either those actually measured for the machinery in question) [condition: or those established on the basis of measurements taken for technically comparable machinery] [DIR, Annex I, 2.2.1.1]
[22] vibration data — hasObligation — must be measured using the most appropriate measurement code for the machinery (must be measured using the most appropriate measurement code for the machinery) [condition: If harmonised standards are not applied] [DIR, Annex I, 2.2.1.1]
[23] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report (a test report) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[24] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) (conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[25] essential requirement 1.6.2, access to operating positions and servicing points — requiresMeasure — allow access in safety (allow access in safety) [condition: where intervention is necessary during operation, adjustment and maintenance of the machinery] [DIR, Annex I, 1.6.2]
[26] full reassessment — hasTimeLimit — every three years (P3Y) [DIR, Annex X]
[27] vibration total value not exceeding 2,5 m/s 2 — hasObligation — Where this value does not exceed 2,5 m/s 2 , this must be mentioned (this must be mentioned) [condition: where this value does not exceed 2,5 m/s 2] [DIR, Annex I, 2.2.1.1]
[28] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — internal checks on the manufacture of machinery (internal checks on the manufacture of machinery) [condition: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[29] devices for the lifting of persons or of persons and goods — listedIn — 14. (annex I, part B, point 14) [condition: involving a hazard of falling from a vertical height of more than 3 m] [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 14]
[30] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2, for each type of machinery or related product concerned] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[31] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (ISO? no) [condition: In order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.4]
[32] CE marking — hasObligation — must be followed by the identification number of the notified body (must be followed by the identification number of the notified body) [condition: Where the full quality assurance procedure referred to in Article 12(3)(c) and 12(4)(b) has been applied] [DIR, Annex III]
[33] movement of the carrier of machinery serving fixed landings — requiresMeasure — rigidly guided (rigidly guided) [condition: to and at the landings] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.1]
[34] carrier designed as a workstation — requiresMeasure — provision shall be made to ensure stability and to prevent hazardous movements (provision shall be made to ensure stability and to prevent hazardous movements) [condition: Where the carrier is designed as a workstation] [REG, Annex III, 6.3.2]
[35] lifting machinery maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[36] internal parts requiring frequent inspection and adjustment, and maintenance areas — requiresMeasure — appropriate lighting (appropriate lighting) [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.4]
[37] movement of the machinery — requiresMeasure — must depend on safe positioning (must depend on safe positioning) [condition: Where it does not give rise to other risks] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.2]
[38] registro di controllo delle attrezzature di lavoro — hasObligation — siano curati la tenuta e l'aggiornamento (siano curati la tenuta e l'aggiornamento) [condition: per cui lo stesso è previsto] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 4]
[39] hydraulic-powered roof supports — listedIn — hydraulic-powered roof supports (annex I, part B, point 12.2) [condition: Machinery for underground working of the following types:] [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 12]
[40] portable hand-held machinery — requiresMeasure — visual observation of the danger zone (visual observation of the danger zone) [condition: where necessary] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.1]
[41] warning and signalling devices — requiresMeasure — the means to check that they are in good working order (the means to check that they are in good working order) [condition: where it is essential for safety] [REG, Annex III, 3.6.1]
[42] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — full quality assurance procedure (full quality assurance procedure) [condition: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[43] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: in order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.5]
[44] loading control 4.2.2 — requiresMeasure — devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements (devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements) [condition: with a maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kg or an overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm] [REG, Annex III, 4.2.2]
[45] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — must use the appropriate verification methods (must use the appropriate verification methods) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.1]
[46] datore di lavoro, interventi di controllo periodici — hasObligation — interventi di controllo periodici (interventi di controllo periodici) [condition: secondo frequenze stabilite in base alle indicazioni fornite dai fabbricanti, ovvero dalle norme di buona tecnica] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[47] guards at landings — requiresMeasure — guards shall be fitted (guards fitted at landings) [condition: where there is a risk due to persons falling into the travel zone when the carrier is not present at the landings] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.8.5]
[48] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — full quality assurance (full quality assurance) [DIR, Annex X]
[49] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report detailing the static and dynamic tests (test report on static and dynamic tests) [condition: where appropriate] [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]

response.text: {"kind":"unknown","value":null,"text":"The facts do not contain the IGEA list or the HINOWA platform at position 24, and they give no verification frequency for that equipment. The only time limit, 'entro dodici mesi' in art. 71, c. 13 of DLGS 81/2008 (DLGS71), concerns how periodic verifications are carried out. It is not tied to this platform, so I cannot state its frequency.","used":[20]}
